# Breath Journal

> > Breath Journal covers climate crisis, ecological transitions, and human wellness through investigative reporting on global environmental challenges and Korean social-cultural stories.

Breath Journal is an editorial platform focused on environmental journalism and cultural reporting, with particular emphasis on climate change impacts, marine ecosystems, greenhouse gas emissions, and Korean heritage preservation. The site combines climate science reporting with human-interest stories about wellness, mental health, and cultural resilience.

## Key Topics

- Climate Change
- Greenhouse Gas Emissions
- Paris Agreement
- Ocean Warming
- Marine Ecosystems
- Korean Fishing Industry
- Ecological Transition
- Mental Health
- Sleep & Insomnia
- Cultural Heritage
- Sustainable Fisheries
- Species Migration
- Environmental Conservation
- Emissions Gap Report
- Intergenerational Knowledge

## Climate & Emissions Crisis

- [2024 Global Greenhouse Gas Emissions Reach 57.7 Gigatons, Setting All-Time High](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/75): Global greenhouse gas emissions hit record 57.7 gigatons per UNEP's 2024 Emissions Gap Report.
- [10th Anniversary of the Paris Agreement COP30, Agreement to Invest $125 Billion in Tropical Forest Protection](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/74): COP30 marks Paris Agreement decade with $125B tropical forest protection investment commitment.
- [[Scenario] 2026 Global Wildfire Calendar: The Unending Cycle of Flames](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/35): Climate simulation forecasts 2026 global wildfire patterns across hemispheres by season.

## Marine Ecosystems & Fisheries

- [The Warming Sea: The Korean Fishing Industry at the Crossroads of Ecological Transition](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/76): Korean fishing industry faces ecological transition amid ocean warming and species migration.
- [The Stork That Flew to Suncheon Bay After Removing Utility Poles](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/71): Suncheon Bay ecological restoration attracts endangered storks after utility pole removal.

## Mental Health & Wellness

- [Half of Koreans in a State of Resentment, Most Severe in Their 30s](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/84): Seoul National University study reveals 50% of Korean adults experience chronic resentment.
- [A Sleepless Night, Signals of Recovery from the Body](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/81): Sleep disorders spike in Korea; cognitive behavioral therapy offers insomnia treatment insights.
- [Brain Training and Dark Showers: Lifestyle Habits that Aid Inner Recovery](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/83): Neuroplasticity training and wellness habits improve sleep and anxiety relief in Korea.

## Korean Cultural Heritage & Preservation

- [Jongmyo World Heritage Cancellation Crisis, the Truth Behind the Sewoon Shopping Center Redevelopment Project and UNESCO's Warning](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/73): UNESCO warns Seoul's Sewoon redevelopment threatens Jongmyo World Heritage status.
- [Ucheon Barian Village in Sacheon, A Loom Song Woven Together by Grandmothers and Students](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/79): Ucheon Barian Village preserves traditional weaving through intergenerational education programs.
- [Jeongseon Raft Culture and Nampyeong Tobang Building Play Designated as Local Cultural Heritage](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/78): Jeongseon County designates raft culture and folk play as protected intangible heritage.
- [The Moat from 600 Years Ago Has Been Revealed Beneath Gijang Eupseong](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/80): Busan archaeological excavation uncovers 15th-century Gijang Eupseong fortress walls and moat.
- [Andong International Mask Dance Festival, A Tradition Shaking Today's City](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/30): Andong's mask dance festival blends traditional Korean culture with modern urban experience.

## Environmental Activism & Conservation

- [Hope Never Dies. Because I Live Within Your Actions](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/82): Jane Goodall's conservation legacy from Gombe primatology research to environmental activism.

## Lifestyle & Travel

- [Camper Van Travel, Becoming a Moving Shelter](https://breathjournal.com/en-us/articles/85): Korea's camping market booms with 7M participants; camper van travel becomes wellness trend.
